title: Get help from a human
description: Short XRP Mobile tutorial: find help from the Support tab. Start a chat with the team, or read the built in FAQ that covers the questions we get most, why 1 XRP is locked in your wallet, how swaps work, where multichain tokens are held, and why a deposit can take a few minutes. Nobody from XRP Mobile will ever ask for your recovery phrase.
lede: Something is not working and you want a person. Before that, the app already answers the questions we get asked most.

steps.caption: Settings, then Support
steps.body: Open the gear and move to Support. Everything about getting help lives on this one tab.

steps.caption: Chat with the team
steps.body: Start a chat puts you through to the team. Nobody there will ever ask for your recovery phrase or your secret numbers, and anyone who does is stealing from you.

steps.caption: The 1 XRP question
steps.body: Under it sits the FAQ, and it opens with the question we get more than any other: why 1 XRP is locked in your wallet.

steps.caption: Swaps, chains and waiting
steps.body: Then how swaps work, where your Bitcoin and Ethereum are actually held, why a deposit takes a few minutes, and whether you can receive from other networks.
